main_conclusions.finding: CR 286/287 are scores of different-net candidates; matching historical lock controls are 283/284, not 286/287.

Available packc/gcx/old-disabled/Coder tactics sources share full SHA256 5002c3c28f7f6f0b076e3b941e5615359f41e182d66ccad9785c4f4a89a0bf7c. They score final bestmove membership in bm minus am. Info PV and first_mate are recorded but do not set solved. No stop command or early-success exit exists in these supplied 48-line scripts.

An available historical canonical-lock final-SAN artifact independently rescores 283/300 with zero legality, parsing or scoring disagreements. Associated run.log identifies the exact e3df executable, 9bfb suite and 5002 tactics. Raw historical UCI transcripts are unavailable; rescoring verifies saved final moves rather than original timing.

The named independent CR cr_netpack_check.sh e45a5204 and f019/f021 raw run directories were not located in the supplied tree or a workspace filename search. Its scoring, settings and guard implementation cannot be proven from related Coder/packc/gcx sources.

S07 final 271 remains correct and sealed. Any-PV scoring is not supported as an explanation for the supplied packc/gcx/Coder metrics. CR-specific any-PV behavior is unknown because the exact CR script is missing.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pack E copy of /workspace/ep10_lock/tactics.py. Only additions: env OPTS="Name=V,Name=V" -> extra setoption lines;
records final score and the first depth/time at which a mate score appears.
usage: tactics.py <engine> <tag> <suite.epd> <movetime_ms> <out.json> [ids_file]
Fresh ucinewgame + Clear Hash per position, Threads=1 Hash=16 OwnBook=false, go movetime T. Solved = bestmove in bm (and not in am)."""
import sys, subprocess, threading, queue, json, time, chess
path, tag, suite, mt, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3], int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
only = set(open(sys.argv[6]).read().split()) if len(sys.argv) > 6 else None
p = subprocess.Popen(['nice','-n','19',path], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True, bufsize=1)

send('uci'); until(lambda l:l=='uciok',10)
import os
extra=[x.split('=') for x in os.environ.get('OPTS','').split(',') if x]
for o in ('Threads value 1','Hash value 16','OwnBook value false'): send('setoption name '+o)
for k,v in extra: send(f'setoption name {k} value {v}')
send('isready'); until(lambda l:l=='readyok',10)
res = {}
for line in open(suite):
    line=line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    b, ops = chess.Board.from_epd(line); pid = ops['id']
    if only and pid not in only: continue
    send('ucinewgame'); send('setoption name Clear Hash'); send('isready'); until(lambda l:l=='readyok',10)
    send('position fen '+b.fen()); send(f'go movetime {mt}')
    t0=time.monotonic()
    ls = until(lambda l:l.startswith('bestmove'), 30)
    el = time.monotonic()-t0
    bm = chess.Move.from_uci(ls[-1].split()[1])
    ok = (bm in ops.get('bm',[]) if 'bm' in ops else True) and bm not in ops.get('am',[])

#!/bin/bash
# Copy of Engine Coder's h256_e12 WAC300 method (tactics.py verbatim): both engines pinned to the same core, 50-position chunks ABBA, sequential, nice 19, pause while load1 >= 5.
cd /workspace/forge-strength/h256tools/packc/tactics_wac300
CORE=${CORE:-6}
BASE=/workspace/forge-strength/build-h256base-expose/forge
NEW=/workspace/forge-strength/build-packc-h256/forge
NEWOPTS="AspFailHighReduce=1,AspFailHighMaxReduce=3,EvalSwingMult=24,EvalSwingMax=200"
S=/workspace/ep10_lock/suites/x_wacnew.epd
w(){ while [ "$(awk '{print int($1)}' /proc/loadavg)" -ge 5 ]; do echo "$(date +%T) load high, waiting"; sleep 20; done; }
one(){ # tag bin mt chunk opts
  w; L0=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg)
  OUT=$(OPTS=$5 taskset -c $CORE nice -n 19 python3 tactics.py $2 $1 $S $3 chunks/$1_$3_c$4.json chunks/ids_$4.txt)
  echo "$(date +%T) mt=$3 chunk=$4 tag=$1 core=$CORE load1_start=$L0 load1_end=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg) :: $OUT" | tee -a chunk_log.txt
}
sha256sum $BASE $NEW $S tactics.py
for MT in 1000 100; do
  for c in 0 1 2 3 4 5; do
    if [ $((c%2)) -eq 0 ]; then one h256base $BASE $MT $c ""; one packc $NEW $MT $c "$NEWOPTS"
    else one packc $NEW $MT $c "$NEWOPTS"; one h256base $BASE $MT $c ""; fi
  done
done
